property_summary: For any admissible feeRate input (0..5000) passed to initialize, the correct contract stores feeRate equal to the provided _feeRate; the mutant inverts the assignment and stores 5000 for many inputs, breaking this equality for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Invert feeRate assignment to store maximum (5000) when input is below cap, otherwise store input; this produces different stored feeRate values.
